# Trendly

> A modern publication exploring technology, AI, and the ideas shaping our future. Written by experts and powered by Google Gemini AI.

## Dynamic AI Context
- [Full Text Feed](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Consolidated plain-text markdown feed containing the full text of our 20 most recent posts, optimized for LLM ingestion.

## Main Navigation
- [Home](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/): The main landing page with the latest and trending articles.
- [Technology](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/category/technology): Articles and analyses focusing on technology breakthroughs.
- [Topics](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/categories): Index of all available article categories.
- [No-as-a-Service](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/no): A showcase of our programmatic integration capabilities.
- [About Us](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/about): Learn how our automated publication flow operates.

## RSS and Feeds
- [RSS Feed](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/feed.xml): Real-time XML feed containing the latest published posts.
- [Google News Sitemap](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/google-news-sitemap.xml): A dedicated Google News sitemap containing articles published in the last 48 hours.
- [Sitemap](https://blogspot-phi.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Standard XML sitemap listing posts, categories, tags, and static pages.
